description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM Parts allows you to convert your 10mm shifter to the more durable 12mm shifter.
It comes with all the Suzuki OEM parts you will need.
Simply swap over your existing shifter case parts to the new shifter case and re-install as usual.
NOTE: This is an upgraded Shifter that Suzuki first installed in the 1990 Samurais. The Shifters in the 1986, 1987, 1988 and 1989 models were failing prematurely due to the small size (10mm) of the Locating Bolt. A recall was debated to retrofit the earlier model Samurais with these parts but never occurred due to the over-all cost. If Suzuki would have implemented a recall these are the parts they would have used.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Shift Lever Case (12mm)
Qty 1 – Shift Lever (12mm)
Qty 1 – Locating Bolt (12mm)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1989 All Models
